panels.description: Keel pump hall before dawn. Alex tests an aging pump by touch; a salvaged bracket replaces the approved part, a white-and-amber node logs his shift and a supervisor watches. Leave upper machinery space clear for two balloons.

Alex touches an exit checkpoint scanner while workers queue behind him. Keep one large vertical display block centered: banner at top, identity and debt facts in the middle, guarantor and restriction below. Reserve a separate right-side zone for the guard balloon, a lower-right zone for Alex’s reply and a small lower scanner zone for the SFX.

Keel street: Alex passes the shuttered Last Chance casino while a bouncer leans in the doorway; a small rationed water queue is visible across the street without recognisable faces. Leave upper corners open.

Empty pump hall terminal with three distinct, widely separated horizontal interface rows: unauthorized-repair alert at top, routine-maintenance reclassification in the middle and lost Site 6 credit at bottom. Reserve uncontested lower-right space for the supervisor balloon.
At sunrise on the exhausted pit rim, Alex faces Oasis while Keel remains in shadow. Keep the restricted status visible and leave lower-left open.

items.speaker: ALEX
items.text: Then don't approve it. Just notice it works.
